title: Normanton Gaol
geometryBasis: Queensland building data supplies two independent roof envelopes. Three topographic points name Normanton Gaol at those envelopes, on the registered site or immediately adjoining its surveyed edge. The larger southwest outline covers the cell ranges; the small rear outline contains the quarters. Open yard walls are inferred inside the heritage site.
sectionBasis: The official heritage description identifies one-storey concrete cells, 3.5 m courtyard walls, the core’s hipped skillion and two roof ventilators, the later pitched roof and three ridge ventilators, and the hipped weatherboard quarters with a covered porch.
limitations: The two roof envelopes come from QRA mapping. The exact exercise yard divisions, core and annex roof breakpoints, porch depth and entrance positions are reconstructed from written facts.
Roof elevations and paint are estimates. Interior fabric, furnishings and proposed park additions are outside scope.
Original terrain stays unchanged; door thresholds and foundation elevations are approximate.
No reference imagery was used. The archive candidate is excluded because its applicable rights are unresolved, and the other candidate does not depict this property.
